app.name: SSH Keys
app.description: Generate, organize and safely export your EveryOS SSH keys.

keys.scope: Your EveryOS key vault is shared with your apps that have SSH key permission. This app generates new keys or imports public keys; it never reads existing host private-key files.
keys.refreshHint: Public metadata refreshes every 15 seconds while active. Form fields and export passphrases stay only in memory.
keys.permission: This app needs secrets:ssh and a role allowed to manage personal keys. An administrator can grant app permissions in the App Store.
keys.cryptoBusy: Another key generation or protected export is running. Try again shortly.
keys.toolMissing: Protected private-key export needs ssh-keygen on the server. Ask an administrator to install the OpenSSH tools.
keys.conflict: This key may already be in your vault, or the 100-key limit was reached. Refresh and check the list.
keys.deletePublic: Delete {{name}} ({{fingerprint}}) from your shared EveryOS vault?
keys.privateHint: Private exports are encrypted OpenSSH files. Enter a passphrase; EveryOS then asks you to confirm this fingerprint. Passphrases are never stored and are cleared after an attempt, cancellation or suspend.
keys.emptyHint: Generate a key, import a public key or change the filters.
keys.importHint: Paste one OpenSSH public-key line. Private keys are not accepted. EveryOS validates the key’s full structure.
keys.name: Name
keys.stale: Refresh failed. The previous snapshot remains visible with its retrieval time.

validation.name: Enter a one-line name of 1–80 characters.
validation.comment: Use one line of at most 200 characters.
validation.publicKey: Paste one supported OpenSSH public-key line, up to 16,384 characters. Do not paste a private key.
validation.passphrase: Use at least 8 characters and at most 1,023 UTF-8 bytes, with no NUL or line breaks.
